title: A study to Evaluate the Effect of AZD4144 on Inflammation in Participants with Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Elevated hsCRP (CALMERA)
official: A Phase IIb, Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicentre Study to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of AZD4144 in Participants with Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Elevated hsCRP (CALMERA)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of AZD4144 on biomarkers of inflammation
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Part A: Global population of non-Chinese descent; Part B: Chinese population of Chinese descent for whom both parents and all grandparents are Chinese, and the participant has not lived outside of China for more than 10 years.
2. History of Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease, defined as at least one of the following: (a) Prior MI (> 30 days from index event) or coronary revascularisation procedure: coronary stenting or coronary artery bypass grafting (> 30 days from index event). (b) Prior large artery atherosclerotic ischaemic stroke (> 30 days from index event); defined as stroke with a ≥ 50% stenosis, endoluminal thrombus, or occlusion in the large artery supplying the ischaemic territory. (c) Symptomatic Peripheral Arterial Disease (defined as at least one of the following): (i) Documented current intermittent claudication with a greater than or equal to 50% stenosis in peripheral artery. (ii) Prior peripheral artery revascularisation procedure or lower extremity amputation at or above ankle due to atherosclerotic disease (excluding eg, trauma or osteomyelitis [> 30 days from index event]). (iii) Current intermittent claudication with an Ankle-brachial index below or equal to 0.90 at rest.
3. Serum hsCRP ≥ 2 and ≤ 10 mg/L at both the Initial and Full Screening Visits during Screening Period.
4. BMI ≥ 18 to ≤ 45 kg/m2.
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of malignancy requiring treatment within the last 5 years (except successfully treated non-metastatic skin basal or squamous cell carcinoma).
2. History of primary immunodeficiency (congenital or acquired) or an underlying condition that predisposes to infection.
3. History of solid organ transplant.
4. Participants with severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated using the CKD-EPI equation using serum creatinine without race), on renal dialysis, and/or those with a history of acute kidney injury, defined as an acute clinically significant decline in kidney function in the past 12 months.
5. Moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score of 7 to 9 [Class B]) or Severe Hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score of 10 to 15 [Class C]), or ALT or AST > 3 × ULN at Screening, or TBL > 1.5×ULN at Screening (unless due to known Gilbert’s syndrome) or History of DILI.
6. Known chronic infection with hepatitis B, hepatitis C.
7. ANC < 1.5 × 10⁹/L.
8. Concomitant or planned use of immunosuppressive treatment, including systemic corticosteroid treatment and colchicine.
9. Received a live or attenuated-live vaccine product within 4 weeks of study intervention administration or expected to receive a live or attenuated-live vaccine product during the treatment period.
10. GLP-1 receptor agonists if started < 6 months before the Screening Period or planned to be initiated during the study.
11. Any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction, or morphology of the resting 12-lead ECG, at Screening.
12. History of QT prolongation associated with other medications that required discontinuation of that medication.
13. Prolonged QTcF > 480 ms during the Screening Period (applicable to all participants, including those with bundle branch block and intraventricular conduction disorder).
14. Any history or evidence of TB (active or latent) using TB QuantiFERON® laboratory tests during the Screening Period.
15. Congenital long QT syndrome.
16. Type II-III AV block sinus node dysfunction with clinically significant sinus pauses untreated with pacemaker).
17. Planned coronary revascularisation or other major surgery.
18. Symptomatic or uncontrolled AF despite treatment (participants with AF/atrial flutter and optimally controlled ventricular rate with resting rate < 100 bpm are permitted).
19. History of heart failure New York Heart Association Class IV.
20. Uncontrolled hypertension (defined as an average SBP > 160 mmHg or an average DBP > 100 mmHg).
21. Active systemic infection (eg, positive blood culture or need for IV antibiotics) within 30 days prior to dosing.
